title: Survey: US public perception of data centers has sharply deteriorated since January, with 54% viewing them as bad for the environment, as local opposition rises (Brian Kennedy/Pew Research Center)
summary: Brian Kennedy / Pew Research Center: Survey: US public perception of data centers has sharply deteriorated since January, with 54% viewing them as bad for the environment, as local opposition rises — Americans have grown more negative toward the possible environmental and economic effects of data centers since the beginning of the year.
